d: Long, flowing vivid magenta hair with blunt bangs frames a youthful, mature face with narrow, sharp magenta eyes. A curvaceous, voluptuous build is dressed in a revealing black and gold outfit featuring a plunging halter neckline, a high-slit skirt with a red underside, and white thigh-high stockings with black boots. The attire is completed by a wide-brimmed black witch hat with a red underbelly and a white band, while the character holds a glowing orange jack-o'-lantern lantern.
